## 2) Inputs

```{r inputs}
n_runs <- 10L
seed_start <- 2026L

root_nb <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/server_json_runs"
root_nm <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/server_json_runs_nm"

run_sources <- tibble::tribble(
  ~run_option, ~alg_dir, ~json_name,
  "Server_SnapATAC", "snapatac", "snapatac.json",
  "Server_InnerProduct", "innerproduct", "innerproduct.json"
)

run_option_levels <- c("Server_SnapATAC", "Server_InnerProduct")

variant_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~variant,    ~method_label,         ~root_kind,
  "raw_gb",    "raw",                 "nb",
```

## 3) Resolve JSON Paths

```{r path_resolve}
resolve_json_path <- function(root, method_name, run_idx, alg_dir, json_name) {
  dset <- sprintf("oocyte_zygote_%s_pairs_r%02d", method_name, run_idx)
  candidates_a <- file.path(root, dset, "1M", alg_dir, json_name)
  candidates_b <- file.path(root, alg_dir, method_name, sprintf("%s_1M_%s", dset, json_name))
  candidates_c <- file.path(root, alg_dir, method_name, json_name)
  candidates <- c(candidates_a, candidates_b, candidates_c)
  hit <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[[1]])
  NA_character_
}

path_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  run_option = run_sources$run_option,
  run = seq_len(n_runs),
  variant = variant_map$variant
) %>%
  left_join(run_sources, by = "run_option") %>%
  left_join(variant_map, by = "variant") %>%
  mutate(
    seed = seed_start + run - 1L,
    root = if_else(root_kind == "nb", root_nb, root_nm),
    method_name = case_when(
      variant == "raw_gb" ~ "raw",
      variant == "imp_gb" ~ "bhzip",
      variant == "raw_nm" ~ "raw_nm",
      variant == "imp_nm" ~ "bhzip_nm",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    json_path = purrr::pmap_chr(
      list(root, method_name, run, alg_dir, json_name),
      resolve_json_path
    ),
    exists = !is.na(json_path)
  )

missing_tbl <- path_tbl %>% filter(!exists)
if (nrow(missing_tbl) > 0) {
  warning("Missing JSON files for some runs/variants. They will be skipped.")
  print(missing_tbl %>% select(run_option, run, seed, variant, method_name, alg_dir))
}

coverage_tbl <- path_tbl %>%
  group_by(run_option, variant) %>%
  summarise(found = sum(exists), total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * found / total))
print(coverage_tbl)
```

## 4) Extract ARI/NMI/Silhouette Families + AvgBIO from JSON

```{r extract}
first_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.list(x)) x <- unlist(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(vals) == 0 || all(is.na(vals))) return(NA_real_)
  vals[which(!is.na(vals))[1]]
}

extract_relevant_metrics <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(tibble(metric = character(), value = numeric()))
  }

  j <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  keys <- names(j)
  if (is.null(keys) || length(keys) == 0) {
    return(tibble(metric = character(), value = numeric()))
  }

  vals <- purrr::map_dbl(keys, ~ first_numeric(j[[.x]]))
  base_df <- tibble(metric = keys, value = vals) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    filter(grepl("(ari|nmi|silhouette)", metric, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(!grepl("silhouette-gt", metric, ignore.case = TRUE))

  best_ari <- first_numeric(j[["best_ari"]])
  best_nmi <- first_numeric(j[["best_nmi"]])
  best_asw <- first_numeric(j[["best_silhouette"]])
  avgBio <- mean(c(best_ari, best_nmi, best_asw), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (all(is.na(c(best_ari, best_nmi, best_asw)))) avgBio <- NA_real_

  bind_rows(base_df, tibble(metric = "avgBio", value = avgBio))
}

metric_order <- c(
  "ari_agglomerative", "ari_gmm", "ari_k-means", "ari_leiden", "ari_louvain", "best_ari",
  "nmi_agglomerative", "nmi_gmm", "nmi_k-means", "nmi_leiden", "nmi_louvain", "best_nmi",
  "silhouette_agglomerative", "silhouette_gmm", "silhouette_k-means",
  "silhouette_leiden", "silhouette_louvain", "best_silhouette",
  "avgBio"
)

metrics_tbl <- path_tbl %>%
  filter(exists) %>%
  mutate(metrics = purrr::map(json_path, extract_relevant_metrics)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(metrics) %>%
  filter(metric %in% metric_order)
```

## 5) Raw Consistency Check: NB raw vs NM raw

```{r raw_consistency_check}
raw_check <- metrics_tbl %>%
  filter(variant %in% c("raw_gb", "raw_nm")) %>%
  select(run_option, run, seed, metric, variant, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variant, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(abs_diff = abs(raw_gb - raw_nm))

raw_check_summary <- raw_check %>%
  group_by(run_option, metric) %>%
  summarise(
    max_abs_diff = ifelse(all(is.na(abs_diff)), NA_real_, max(abs_diff, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_abs_diff = ifelse(all(is.na(abs_diff)), NA_real_, mean(abs_diff, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(run_option, desc(max_abs_diff), metric)

print(raw_check_summary, n = 40)

tolerance <- 1e-12
raw_mismatch <- raw_check_summary %>% filter(is.finite(max_abs_diff) & max_abs_diff > tolerance)
if (nrow(raw_mismatch) == 0) {
  message("Raw consistency check passed: raw_gb and raw_nm are numerically identical within tolerance.")
} else {
  warning("Raw consistency check found differences above tolerance. Please inspect `raw_check_summary`.")
}
```

```{r plot, fig.width=15, fig.height=9}
group_boundaries <- tibble::tibble(

    grepl("^ari|best_ari$", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ARI",
```

## 10) Run 1 PCA2D Visualization (from anndata `X_pca`)

```{r pca2d_visualization_run1}
read_h5ad_obs_col <- function(obs_group, key) {
  node <- obs_group[[key]]
  if (inherits(node, "H5Group")) {
    nms <- names(node)
    if (all(c("codes", "categories") %in% nms)) {
      codes <- as.integer(node[["codes"]]$read())
      categories <- as.character(node[["categories"]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[codes + 1L]))
    }
  }
  if (inherits(node, "H5D")) {
    vals <- node$read()
    attrs <- tryCatch(hdf5r::h5attr_names(node), error = function(e) character(0))
    if ("categories" %in% attrs) {
      cats_obj <- hdf5r::h5attr(node, "categories")
      categories <- as.character(cats_obj$dereference()[[1]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[as.integer(vals) + 1L]))
    }
    return(as.vector(as.character(vals)))
  }
  stop("Unsupported obs encoding for key: ", key)
}

read_h5ad_pca2d <- function(path) {
  h5 <- hdf5r::H5File$new(path, mode = "r")
  on.exit(try(h5$close_all(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  if (!("obsm" %in% names(h5)) || !("X_pca" %in% names(h5[["obsm"]]))) {
    stop("Missing obsm/X_pca in: ", path)
  }
  x_pca <- as.matrix(h5[["obsm"]][["X_pca"]]$read())
  if (ncol(x_pca) < 2) stop("X_pca has fewer than 2 columns in: ", path)

  celltype <- factor(as.vector(read_h5ad_obs_col(h5[["obs"]], "celltype")))
  if (nrow(x_pca) != length(celltype) && ncol(x_pca) == length(celltype)) {
    x_pca <- t(x_pca)
  }
  if (nrow(x_pca) != length(celltype)) {
    stop("X_pca shape mismatch with celltype labels in: ", path)
  }

  tibble(
    PC1 = x_pca[, 1],
    PC2 = x_pca[, 2],
    celltype = celltype
  )
}
```

## 11) Example Contact Heatmap (One Cell, One Chromosome) for Raw / NB / NM

```{r example_contact_heatmap_three_inputs}
# Build one-cell, one-chromosome contact heatmaps from pair files.
# If an input folder is missing locally, keep a blank panel with a note.

anchor_path <- "D:/Codex/Test/external/SCORE/examples/data/mm10.genome_split_1M"
raw_pair_dir <- "D:/Codex/Test/external/SCORE/examples/data/oocyte_zygote_mm10/1M"
nb_pair_dir  <- "D:/Codex/Test/data/bhzip_score_compare_from_pairs/bhzip_1M"
nm_pair_dir  <- "D:/Codex/Test/data/bhzip_score_compare_from_pairs_nm/bhzip_nm_1M"

target_chr <- "chr1"
requested_cell <- NULL  # set e.g. "anchor_loop.101_pronucleus-male.1M" to force one cell

if (!file.exists(anchor_path)) stop("Missing anchor file: ", anchor_path)
anchors <- read.delim(anchor_path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(anchors) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "idx0")

chr_ids <- anchors$idx0[anchors$chr == target_chr]
if (length(chr_ids) < 2) stop("Chromosome not found or too few bins: ", target_chr)

read_pair_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) return(NULL)
  x <- tryCatch(read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0 || ncol(x) < 3) return(NULL)
  x <- x[, 1:3]
  colnames(x) <- c("bin1", "bin2", "count")
  x$bin1 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x$bin1))
  x$bin2 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x$bin2))
  x$count <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$count))
  x <- x[!is.na(x$bin1) & !is.na(x$bin2) & !is.na(x$count), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
  x
}

build_chr_mat <- function(pair_dir, cell_file, chr_ids) {
  n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
  f <- file.path(pair_dir, cell_file)
  d <- read_pair_file(f)
  if (is.null(d)) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  keep <- d$bin1 %in% chr_ids & d$bin2 %in% chr_ids
  d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  old2new <- integer(max(chr_ids) + 1L)
  old2new[chr_ids + 1L] <- seq_len(n_bins)
  i <- old2new[d$bin1 + 1L]
  j <- old2new[d$bin2 + 1L]

  ok <- i > 0 & j > 0 & !is.na(i) & !is.na(j)
  i <- i[ok]; j <- j[ok]; w <- d$count[ok]
  if (length(i) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins)
  for (k in seq_along(i)) {
    ii <- i[k]; jj <- j[k]
    mat[ii, jj] <- mat[ii, jj] + w[k]
    if (ii != jj) mat[jj, ii] <- mat[jj, ii] + w[k]
  }
  mat
}

pick_example_cell <- function(dirs) {
  available <- dirs[dir.exists(dirs)]
  if (length(available) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  file_sets <- lapply(available, function(d) list.files(d, full.names = FALSE))
  common <- Reduce(intersect, file_sets)
  if (length(common) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (!is.null(requested_cell) && requested_cell %in% common) return(requested_cell)
  sort(common)[1]
}

cell_file <- pick_example_cell(c(raw_pair_dir, nb_pair_dir, nm_pair_dir))
if (is.na(cell_file)) {
  warning("Could not find a common cell across available input pair directories.")
  cell_file <- "NA"
}

input_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~method,            ~pair_dir,    ~label,
  "Raw",              raw_pair_dir, "Raw",
  "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)",   nb_pair_dir,  "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)",
  "HiCBZIP-N(M)",     nm_pair_dir,  "HiCBZIP-N(M)"
)

mat_to_df <- function(mat, method, label, available, note) {
  if (!available || is.null(mat)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      method = method, label = label, i = 1, j = 1, count = NA_real_,
      available = FALSE, note = note
    ))
  }
  n <- nrow(mat)
  expand.grid(i = seq_len(n), j = seq_len(n), KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      count = as.numeric(mat[cbind(i, j)]),
      method = method,
      label = label,
      available = TRUE,
      note = ""
    )
}

hm_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(input_tbl)), function(ix) {
  method_i <- input_tbl$method[ix]
  dir_i <- input_tbl$pair_dir[ix]
  label_i <- input_tbl$label[ix]

  if (!dir.exists(dir_i)) {
    return(mat_to_df(NULL, method_i, label_i, FALSE, paste("Missing dir:", dir_i)))
  }
  if (!file.exists(file.path(dir_i, cell_file))) {
    return(mat_to_df(NULL, method_i, label_i, FALSE, paste("Missing cell file:", cell_file)))
  }
  mat <- build_chr_mat(dir_i, cell_file, chr_ids)
  mat_to_df(mat, method_i, label_i, TRUE, "")
})

heat_df <- bind_rows(hm_list) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("Raw", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)")))

note_df <- heat_df %>%
  group_by(method, label, available, note) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!available)

# Flayamer style: plot log1p(count) with a shared 99.5% cap across shown panels.
heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(value = log1p(count))

pos_vals <- heat_df$value[is.finite(heat_df$value) & heat_df$value > 0]
count_max <- if (length(pos_vals) > 0) {
  as.numeric(stats::quantile(pos_vals, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE))
} else {
  suppressWarnings(max(heat_df$value, na.rm = TRUE))
}
if (!is.finite(count_max)) count_max <- 1
count_max <- max(count_max, 1e-6)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = j, y = i, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 3, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, count_max), option = "plasma", na.value = "grey95", name = "log1p") +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Example Contact Heatmap | ", target_chr, " | cell: ", cell_file),
    subtitle = "Raw vs HiCBZIP-NB(GS) vs HiCBZIP-N(M) | scale=log1p(count), cap=99.5%",
    x = "bin",
    y = "bin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

if (nrow(note_df) > 0) {
  p_heat <- p_heat +
    geom_text(
      data = note_df,
      aes(x = 1, y = 1, label = note),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3.2
    )
}
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=4.8}
print(p_heat)
```
